summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, announcing the board meeting date for Q2 2026 consolidated financial results (July 29) and the designation of banks for its 1st and 2nd domestic unsecured convertible corporate bond. This is a routine disclosure of a scheduled board meeting and a financing administrative update. No special-situation event — no change of control, restructuring, or strategic action is involved. Mapping from Taiwan under Rule 13a-16, the filing serves as an ordinary current report.
